name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.transport.mirror
description: Mirror transport bridge over a Signal Fish room: the room authority plays the Mirror server, members play clients, and game traffic rides the v3 binary relay lane. Requires the Mirror asset (Asset Store or Assets/ install; detected by the included editor define detector) and com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.

samples.description: A SignalFishRoomManager bootstrap plus a driver NetworkBehaviour that shows the host/client flows, late joining an existing room by code, and rejoining after a drop.
